rule_title: TTP T1068 - PrintNightmare: spoolsv.exe spawns cmd.exe as SYSTEM
description: Detects the Print Spooler service (spoolsv.exe) spawning cmd.exe running as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM. The spooler should never spawn interactive shells — this is the hallmark of PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-1675 / CVE-2021-34527) exploitation. The observed event shows spoolsv.exe as parent, cmd.exe as child, running at System integrity level in a terminal session.
